text:
jordan_sales: Heads up—Rivermark Bank returned the SIG and asked for per-question evidence. I started answers but need artifacts for Q12 (KMS), Q27 (audit logs), Q41 (pen test), Q58 (data residency). Who can pick these up?
priya_k: I can take KMS + a short note on envelope encryption. Paste the sheet?
jordan_sales: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SALES/pages/RIVERMARK/SIG-answers (tab RIVERMARK_SIG_2026)
alex_w: pinging engsec-bot for pen test + SOC2 attachments. @engsec-bot please drop links. :pray:
engsec-bot: Uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/rivermark/2026-04/pentest-summary-redacted.pdf, s3://redwood-sec-evidence/rivermark/2026-04/soc2-report.pdf
leah_ops: For Q27: retention and example query. We keep prod logs 365d; non-prod 90d. Confluence doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/Log+Retention. Sample CloudWatch Logs Insights query:
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter service = \"inference-runtime\" and level in [\"ERROR\", \"WARN\"]
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50
```
priya_k: KMS: Dedicated/Private support CMKs. Hosted uses envelope with provider CMK. Evidence: KMS policy JSON and rotation note. s3://redwood-sec-evidence/rivermark/MANIFEST/MANIFEST_kms_policy.json
priya_k: Key lifecycle snippet to paste in sheet:
```
rotation: true
rotation_period_days: 365
administrators: [redwood-kms-admin, infra-team]
```
maria_g: Q41: we provide redacted pen test summary; full report via NDA. Has NDA been exchanged? @jordan_sales
jordan_sales: NDA sent yesterday. Legal is reviewing. Summary is fine until NDA is finalized.
alex_w: Q58: Rivermark wants EU-only backups. For Dedicated we can enforce region lock and place backups in customer-owned S3. Diagram: https://redwood.app/diagrams/rivermark-dedicated-backups.png. Backup policy file: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/rivermark/backup-policy.md
leah_ops: Adding a support case example where we implemented regional pin: internal case CASE-2024-7732 (redacted). Link: https://support.redwood.ai/cases/CASE-2024-7732 (view restricted)
priya_k: CLI to extract last 90 days of KMS events from CloudTrail (paste in evidence):
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2026-01-01 --end-time 2026-03-31 --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GenerateDataKey --query 'Events[]' > rivermark_kms_events.json
```
jordan_sales: Please prefix files with RIVERMARK_SIG_ when you upload so I can attach easily.
engsec-bot: Files uploaded with prefix: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/rivermark/RIVERMARK_SIG_pentest-summary.pdf, s3://redwood-sec-evidence/rivermark/RIVERMARK_SIG_kms-policy.json, s3://redwood-sec-evidence/rivermark/RIVERMARK_SIG_log-retention.md
maria_g: Draft answer for Q41: "Annual third-party penetration test performed; redacted summary attached. Full report available upon NDA."
priya_k: Draft answer for Q12: "Supports customer-managed CMKs for Dedicated/Private. Hosted uses envelope encryption with provider CMKs. See attached KMS policy (RIVERMARK_SIG_kms-policy.json)."
leah_ops: I updated Q27 entry with retention durations and sample query + link to logs doc. Marked which artifacts are shareable vs NDA.
jordan_sales: final check—can someone sanity-check Q34 (subprocessors) and Q49 (incident response SLA)? I put quick notes but need cert.
alex_w: Subprocessors list: AWS (infra), Fastly (CDN), Datadog (monitoring). I'll add a small table mapping roles.
maria_g: Incident response SLA: On-call initial triage within 15 min for Sev1, follow-up milestones at 1h and 4h. SLA doc attached: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/rivermark/RIVERMARK_SIG_incident-sla.pdf
jordan_sales: Great. I'll finish the sheet and send to Rivermark. Thanks all :thumbsup:
leah_ops: leaving notes in the sheet about redactions.
engsec-bot: Reminder: tag any NDA-only artifacts with [NDA_REQUIRED] in the spreadsheet.
priya_k: I'll offer a short walkthrough to their security team on KMS evidence if they request it.
maria_g: happy to join if they want redaction guidance.
jordan_sales: closing loop—will post update when they confirm receipt.
